text: Today is Skanda Shashthi, a very sacred day dedicated to Lord Skanda (Murugan).
• Perform abhishekam to the Vel, or light a diya before an image of Skanda Bhagwan.
• Chant 'Om Saravana Bhava' 108 times with devotion.
• Listen to or recite the Skanda Kavacham.
• Offer a simple naivedyam to the Lord.
May this simple sadhana bring peace, focus, and divine grace into your life.
